title: Graduate Engineer | Water Engineering - Flooding
content_text:
Graduate Engineer | Water Engineering - Flooding. Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. Asia Pacific Region.
See it differently You see the world through a unique lens and that's exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently - it's essential for creating a sustainable future.
Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates to help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.
The Opportunity: A career at Arup offers you the chance to make a positive difference in the world. We are looking for a Graduate to join our Flooding team in Brisbane in March 2027.
Our graduate experience offers you: Purpose-driven work; Create remarkable outcomes; Inclusive culture; Career growth; Work-life balance (hybrid model).
Is this role right for you? We're looking for: Changemakers, Innovative minds, Growth seekers, Adaptable adventurers.
Eligibility: To be considered for a graduate opportunity your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:
- Minimum Bachelor's level qualification in Civil Engineering or Environmental Engineering
- Full working rights in the country of application
- No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role
- Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree before employment starts
Duplicate applications: Candidates will only be considered for one application. If multiple applications are submitted, only the first eligible application received will be considered.
Advert closing date: Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.
What we offer you: fair and equitable total reward package, health and wellbeing benefits, learning opportunities, community engagement programme.
Equal opportunity employer. Contact APACEarlyCareers@arup.com for assistance or reasonable adjustments.
apply_instructions: Apply online via Arup Careers (jobs.arup.com); application must include a copy of academic transcript. Only first eligible application considered; may close early if high volume.
